newsitem.title: LIBERIA: Liberia poll commission rejects election delay bid.
newsitem.headline: Liberia poll commission rejects election delay bid.

text.p: The head of Liberia's independent election commission on Wednesday rejected calls for a delay in July 19 presidential and parliamentary elections by 12 of the 13 political parties putting up candidates.
"The elections will take place unfailingly on July 19," Harry Andrews told a news conference. "I wish to assure the public that the holding of elections is firmly on course."
The elections are the culmination of a peace deal brokered by Liberia's West African neighbours to end end seven years of a civil war that has killed well over 150,000 people.
Supporters of a delay had denounced fraud and irregularities during voter registration, which ended on Wednesday after a three-day extension.
